abstract: Placental Site Trophoblastic Tumor (PSTT) is a rare form of Gestational Trophoblastic Disease (GTD). Approximately 200 cases have been reported in the literature. This disease has unpredictable biological behavior, whereas approximately 10-15% have clinically malignant evolution. We present the case of a 21-year old woman at first pregnancy without known previous abortion at 25 weeks of amenorrhea who was admitted to the hospital for hyperemesis, hepatic problems and important weight loss registered during the last few months. Few days after the admission, the patient suddenly died before the doctors can reach a diagnosis. A forensic investigation for medical malpractice was initiated. Samples collected from uterus at the autopsy revealed large trophoblastic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm. Deposition of fibrinoid material was noticed between trophoblastic cells. Tumor cells dissected through the myometrium and invaded into the vascular spaces. Specimens of the lungs revealed numerous small neoplastic emboli into the vessels. We show autopsy and histological findings of PSTT in a young woman, which are very rarely described in the literature and we discuss the medico-legal implications related to the great difficulties of the gynecologists who faced this rare condition in term of diagnosis and prediction of biological behavior, outlining effective therapeutic approaches.
abstract_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）は妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の稀な一型である。約200例が文献に報告されている。本疾患は予測困難な生物学的挙動を示し、約10〜15%が臨床的に悪性の経過をたどる。本報告では、妊娠初回で、既往の流産歴のない25週の21歳女性が、悪阻、肝機能障害、数か月来の著明な体重減少のため入院した症例を提示する。入院数日後、医師が診断に至る前に患者は突然死亡した。医療過誤に関する法医学的調査が開始された。剖検時の子宮の検体では、好酸性の細胞質を持つ大型の栄養膜細胞が認められた。栄養膜細胞間にフィブリノイド物質の沈着が認められた。腫瘍細胞は筋層を貫通して進展し、血管腔へ浸潤していた。肺の検体では、血管内に多数の微小な腫瘍塞栓が認められた。若年女性におけるPSTTの剖検所見と組織所見を示し、この極めて稀な疾患の診断と生物学的挙動の予測において産婦人科医が直面する大きな困難と、医学的・法的問題について論じる。効果的な治療アプローチの概要も示す。
